2.2.1.en: Major improvement on calculation method, more improved settings and introduction of prayer Widget

2.2.2.en: Refresh of App Architecture and Introdcution of Widgets

2.2.3.en: update the app settings, engine and introduced features

2.2.5.en: added new settings and prayers widget fixes

2.3.1.en: fix the volume slider percentage causing flow issue

2.4.0.en: Added: "Any prayer" option on the Before/After Prayer trigger. Improved trigger reliability (no duplicate fires).

2.4.1.en: Fixed: "Prayer name is/is not" condition now works correctly under the Before/After Any prayer trigger (e.g. excluding Sunrise).

2.4.3.en: Fixed widget preview images to comply with Homey App Store guidelines (abstract shapes, no text, transparent background). Updated default full adhan to Al-Ghamdi Makkah recording (cdn.aladhan.com/audio/adhans/a1.mp3).

2.4.4.en: audio settings always show default URLs, simplified reset and save buttons

2.4.5.en: Fixed prayer-time tiles on the Settings page showing a value that didn't match the 5-day preview table; the fine-tune table now also refreshes live as you adjust.

3.0.0.en: New: AI Islamic assistant powered by Claude. Ask questions or schedule daily content (verses, hadith, dua, fatwa) delivered straight to Telegram, with a built-in preset library.

3.1.0.en: Assistant replies now have interactive Telegram buttons (More, Explain, Summarize, navigation) that respond instantly, including on scheduled messages. Fixed buttons that could fail silently.
